The plugin returns bounded observations and opaque handles rather than native paths, then must close that state when the run ends. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Agent computer tool] --> B[Gateway node command] B --> C[Run execution owner] C --> D[CUA plugin] D --> E[Opaque resource validation] E --> F[CUA driver session] F --> G[Recording or browser result] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Forward terminal cleanup into every executable harness (P1)** - This filter removes all six execution-owned actions when no callback is supplied.
